appliedUpdates.description: Added Flow Validator Guidance section for Native Desktop UI - Multi-Viewport Rendering with testing approach, isolation strategy, and validation constraints

summary: All 8 assertions for multi-viewport-rendering milestone passed successfully. Integration tests confirm viewport pass rendering to transient textures, multiple viewport passes in frame graph, and independent camera configurations. Visual verification confirms viewport positioning, split-screen layouts, and four-viewport grid are working correctly. Vulkan validation shows zero synchronization errors, and extended run confirms stable rendering with no artifacts.
keyFindings: Viewport pass correctly renders to transient textures with proper resource descriptors
Frame graph supports multiple simultaneous viewport passes with unique resource names
Each viewport maintains independent configuration (extents, formats, clear colors)
Viewport positioning works correctly with ViewportRect structure and CompositePass integration
Split-screen layouts (Horizontal2, Vertical2) implemented and working
Four viewport grid (Quad2x2) fully functional with proper quadrant positioning
Zero Vulkan validation synchronization errors - barrier synchronization working correctly
Stable rendering over 30-second extended run with no visual artifacts
Pre-existing heap corruption on shutdown (from particle system refactor) does not affect multi-viewport functionality

frictions.description: Application crashes with heap corruption (exit code 0xc0000374) during shutdown
frictions.resolution: Identified as pre-existing issue from commit 8222a5d (particle system modernization). Does not affect multi-viewport rendering functionality. Crash occurs only during particle system cleanup, not during rendering.

frictions.description: Vulkan validation warning about running both GPU-assisted and core check validation simultaneously
frictions.resolution: Performance warning only, not a functional issue. Both validation layers enabled for thorough testing.
